subject: Harness judge: review T5 scorer + CLI + scorecard attempt
description: Single-attempt review (self-learn-judge, single-attempt review mode) of T5. Rubric: (1) scorer matches each benchmark's OFFICIAL metric — LLM-judge accuracy (ported prompts), abstention = correct-iff-refused, per-category; LoCoMo token-F1 secondary. (2) gold used ONLY in the scorer, never re-entering the runner. (3) run.py CLI is coherent + resumable. (4) SCORECARD section uses the SOUND framing — contrast axis, our-way reads /task/context, cold shown, number marked pending full run, no overclaim, caveats disclosed (candidate-gen still embeds; LoCoMo dispute). (5) stdlib-only; scope = scorer.py + run.py + report + SCORECARD only; style. Under the agent-memory-bench feature: APPROVE → merge_attempt into feature; KICK BACK → set_status failed + wired record_decision. Never force-merge.
